login.title: Cenel jọgkạmiạ login
login.welcome: Arhõ̠ sạgun darame! Amak’ ạyurkọ bebosta lạgit sain in me̱.
login.heroTitle: Apeak̕ jo̠to̠ lead sãote apeak̕ real-estate kạmi bạṛti idipe
login.heroIntro: Mit̕ṭen portal re gạhki ko registration lạgit̕, apnar lead ko lạgit̕ credit dohoe ar booking hạbic̕ onkoak̕ pańja.

register.title: Sekend re lead ko registration me
register.text: Amak’ gạhki ar uniak’ kusi menak’ project jọmae me̱.

protect.title: Duplikat khon bańcao
protect.text: Apeak̕ lead do̠ kạmi lạgit̕ apeak̕ ge tahena, onate eṭak̕ ho̠ṛ do̠ ona gạhki do̠ bako claim daṛeak̕a.

track.title: Joto stage re track huyu aa
track.text: Mimit’ lead reak’ sthiti ar purạ itihas ńel me, pạhil jogajog khon booking hạbic’.

handover.title: Buking re kredit
handover.text: Mit̕ṭen gạhki puthi kạmi jokhec̕, source partner lekate am sãote kạmi lạgit̕ lead do̠ kạmiạko ṭhen em hoyok̕ kana.

login.secure: Rakhawak’ sain-in - amak’ gạhkikọak’ bibọrnọn nijerak’ tahẽn kana

signup.title: Cēnēla jōgāra rējistrēśana
